unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 11 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.3 - THEME 8: LIFE IN THE UNIVERSE & THE FUTURE

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will explore the current theme by imagining three major technological advancements, such as artificial intelligence, global internet connection, and renewable energy. They will create a short video discussing how these technologies could change the world by underlining both the benefits and challenges. They will also offer a conceptual model of a futuristic technology that addresses a global challenge on Earth and possibly in space. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''life in the universe and the future with its components such as predictions about technology and advancement in the next century; robots today and the future with robots; space as a source of inspiration for future generations'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in after prep year 11 of upper secondary school may know what predictions about technology and advancement in the next century; robots today and the future with robots; space as a source of inspiration for future generations mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in after prep year 11 of upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''universal universe and the future'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year, and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in the after prep year 11 of an upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''life in the universe and the future with its components such as predictions about technology and advancement in the next century; robots today and the future with robots; space as a source of inspiration for future generations'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/ or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To express their opinions about predictions about technology and advancement in the next century; robots today and in the future in English by using target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: Technology and Robots In this activity, students engage in a debate about the future impact of technology and robots on society. The class is divided into two groups: one group argues that technology and robots have a positive impact, while the other students argue that they bring challenges and risks. Each group prepares predictions about the future by making logical arguments with future-related language such as ''likely, probable, and life-changing''. They also use the target grammar in their statements. For example, ''If robots had been used in healthcare earlier, many lives would have been saved'' or ''I wish we had focused on automation earlier''. After the preparation, each group presents their arguments. Finally, the teacher gives feedback on the use of target pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To talk about predictions about technology and advancement in the next century in English by using target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: Future Predictionse The teacher reviews the target vocabulary by using flashcards. S/he shows the flashcards one by one and asks students to repeat the word aloud and explain its meaning or use it in a sentence. After the flashcard activity, students work in small groups, and s/he asks them to produce a prediction about the future by using at least three of the target vocabulary words. Then, students practice by forming sentences such as: ''If they __________ (start) the project earlier, they __________ (complete) it on time''. ''She wishes she __________ (attend) the seminar on space exploration last year''. Later, they read the sentences aloud, and the teacher listens and gives feedback on pronunciation and sentence correctness. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
